rubric.abstention_rule: NO_MATERIAL_ECONOMIC_DELTA is a SUCCESSFUL result when the state genuinely does not bear on the decision; the world model is not required to speak
rubric.attribution_rule: a material field with no trigger, mechanism and provenance is MATERIAL_BUT_UNATTRIBUTED and is not credited

criteria.actionability: action is not HOLD when an adverse channel exists
criteria.decision_relevance: did a decision field move at all
criteria.information_value: count and movement of information requests
criteria.mechanism_quality: share of risks carrying a mechanism
criteria.non_redundancy: B's material fields must carry economic_inputs A did not have
criteria.priority_quality: did top_priority name a channel with an adverse reading
criteria.uncertainty_honesty: each risk carries a standing of OBSERVED, INFERRED or UNKNOWN, and unknowns are listed explicitly

rubric.judge: STRUCTURAL ONLY. No LLM judge is used as a scorer anywhere in this rubric; every criterion below is computed from the structured analysis object, so the score cannot flatter the system that produced it.
